title: I finally managed to get my Godot game running in the browser! (Web build out now)
author: Final_Huckleberry408
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/z1i023a6pbyh1.png

Hey everyone!

I'm super excited to share that I finally got a web build of my game up and running! It took some tweaking, but it is officially playable right in the browser.

Just a heads up: since it is a web export, there are currently a few graphical bugs and some minor performance limitations compared to the native version. However, the core gameplay is fully there and ready to go.

I would love it if you could test it out and give me your feedback!

Let me know what you think, what breaks, or what feels good. I am already working on fixing these web quirks, and I will be releasing a fully updated, much smoother downloadable demo for Windows very soon!

Thanks for checking it out!  
[https://guilhermeandradejid-eng.itch.io/grayfall-demo](https://guilhermeandradejid-eng.itch.io/grayfall-demo)  
takes some time to start but work!
